creative_constraints.freshness_instruction: Generate completely new lyrics. Do not copy existing nursery rhymes, film songs, poems, or copyrighted lyrics.

song.music_prompt: A Hindi nursery rhyme with a light pop rhythm. Use ukulele strumming, hand claps, soft tabla, xylophone melodies, and light synth bells. Keep the tempo around 105 BPM. Mood is playful, bright, and happy. Medium-high energy suitable for a space adventure vibe. Clear, friendly vocals by an adult or older child, simple phrasing and easy rhymes. Target audio duration is about 90 seconds.
